links.outcome: In-hospital mortality, length of stay, sepsis, and ICU transfers with versus without the early warning system
links.effect: Intervention had 35.6% lower instantaneous risk of death (aHR 0.64), 11.2% shorter length of stay, and 7.5% lower sepsis risk; unanticipated ICU transfer risk rose 24.9% (aHR 1.25).
links.quote: A machine learning-based EWS, modeled on nursing surveillance patterns, decreased inpatient deterioration risk with statistical significance.

screen.reason: Pragmatic cluster-randomized trial evaluating the clinical impact of deploying a real-time machine learning early warning system (CONCERN EWS) vs usual care on patient outcomes.

primary.practice: real-time clinical decision support alert deployment
